title: Flickering tube light in Room 204
description: The tube light near the whiteboard flickers constantly and makes it hard to read notes during evening classes.

title: Leaking tap outside Boys Hostel Block 2
description: The wash-area tap near the entrance has been leaking continuously for a week, wasting water and flooding the floor.

title: Broken chair in Library reading hall
description: One of the wooden chairs in the silent reading hall has a cracked leg and wobbles dangerously.

title: Overflowing dustbin near Canteen
description: The dustbin outside the canteen entrance overflows by lunchtime every day and hasn't been cleared in days.

title: Damaged door hinge in Lab 3
description: The Computer Lab 3 door doesn't close properly because the top hinge has come loose, letting the AC out.

title: Charging point not working in Auditorium
description: None of the USB charging points along the auditorium side wall are functioning, needed for event days.

title: Torn notice board glass in Block C
description: The glass cover of the department notice board is cracked and a piece is missing, notices keep falling out.

title: Squeaky ceiling fan in Room 118
description: The ceiling fan makes a loud squeaking noise on every rotation, quite distracting during lectures.
